entity.name: Shivam Singh
entity.description: Independent researcher and developer building open-source swarm robotics simulation and control systems. I am the sole maintainer of the Swarm Robotics project, which has grown from 2,075 to 3,640 lines of production-grade code with 17 passing tests. Funding will support compute infrastructure for rigorous benchmarking (400+ configuration matrix, 30+ trials each), ROS2 integration, and travel to present at IEEE ICRA 2027 in Seoul, South Korea.

projects.name: Swarm Robotics Simulation
projects.description: A production-grade multi-agent simulation platform for autonomous drone swarms. Features include: TDMA/D-TDMA communication protocols, packet loss simulation, ghost drone fault tolerance (self-healing task reallocation), CBBA task allocation, Reynolds rules, Voronoi partitioning, A/B testing UI, 3D Plotly visualization, and Dockerized deployment. Currently at 3,640 LOC with 17/17 passing tests. Target: IEEE ICRA 2027, Seoul, South Korea.

plans.name: Compute & Benchmarking Infrastructure
plans.description: Dedicated compute server to run the full benchmark suite across 432 configurations with 30+ trials each, generating statistically significant results for IEEE publication.

plans.name: ROS2 Integration & Hardware Path
plans.description: Port the entire CBBA+TDMA logic to ROS2 with Gazebo simulation using Crazyflie/TurtleBot models, laying the foundation for physical drone testing.

plans.name: ICRA 2027 Conference Travel
plans.description: Travel, accommodation, and registration for ICRA 2027 in Seoul, South Korea (May 24-28, 2027) to present the swarm resilience research.

plans.name: Maintainer Time & Sustained Development
plans.description: Sustained funding to support continued development, maintenance, and community support for the Swarm Robotics project.
